cs.t: Yes. My TI-30X has been in my backpack since I started college 17 years ago. It still works flawlessly every time I pull it out

cs.t: Use the Python interactive CLI most of the time. I still have a TI30x around for the few times I don't have my laptop around, like when doing electronics or wood working. I could use my phone for that, but I really prefer using a proper keyboard than a touchscreen for that task.
